## Context: “original” biclaR

![](images/biclar_original.png){fig-align="center" width="95%"}

::: {style="text-align: center; font-size: 0.92em; margin-top: 0.3em;"}
Tool to help plan **AML’s cycling network**, based on different **trip patterns** and **modal share objectives**.
:::

## Objective

- **Tool for implementation and dimensioning of bike parking infrastructure.**
- **Models proposed:**

::: {layout-ncol="2" style="margin-top: 0.4em;"}

::: {.dim-card style="background: #e8f4fd; border-left: 4px solid #2c6fad; padding: 0.8em 1em; border-radius: 6px;"}
**📏 Minimum ratios**  
Minimum nº of parking spots required by local regulations or literature, according to land use (*residential, POI, PT station, school*).
:::

::: {.dim-card style="background: #fff8e1; border-left: 4px solid #ffc107; padding: 0.8em 1em; border-radius: 6px;"}
**🛍️ Short-term**  
Focused on short daytime trips (*e.g. to commercial areas*).
:::

::: {.dim-card style="background: #e8f8ee; border-left: 4px solid #28a745; padding: 0.8em 1em; border-radius: 6px;"}
**🏠💼 Long-term**  
Focused on both ends of commuting trips (*residential and work*).
:::

::: {.dim-card style="background: #fde8e8; border-left: 4px solid #dc3545; padding: 0.8em 1em; border-radius: 6px;"}
**🚆 Intermodal**  
Focused on first and last mile of journeys made by **PT**.
:::

:::

- **Modal share targets:** [2%]{.target-badge} [4%]{.target-badge} [10%]{.target-badge}

## Data sources and tools

- **H3 resolution 9** grid.
- **Dasymetric population map:**  
  [Census]{.flow-pill} $\leftrightarrow$ [Land use]{.flow-pill} $\leftrightarrow$ [Building data (GBA)]{.flow-pill}

::: {style="margin-top: 0.6em;"}
| Source | Data / Used for |
|---|---|
| **OpenStreetMap (OSM)** | Buildings, POIs, cycling network, parking infrastructure, … |
| **TML** | Validations at PT stops |
| **Micro-mobility operators** | GBFS data |
